status: frozen before stationary-cluster support or deployment-overlap outputs were opened
purpose: Determine, using x-y/time and deployment metadata only, which frozen panels can support an empirical stationary-height offset correction. Numeric vertical values are prohibited in this preflight.

inputs_allowed: deployment/tag identifiers from source reference metadata
stationary_definition.neighbor_rule: A fix is stationary-candidate only if it has both a previous and next fix in the same frozen session; both adjacent time gaps are >0 and <=1200 s; and both adjacent horizontal speeds are <=0.5 m/s.

panel_feasibility_rule.minimum_supported_individuals: max(5, ceil(0.5 × original evaluable individual count))
panel_feasibility_rule.cohort_requirement: At least one originally admitted cohort must contain >=3 supported individuals each with >=2 originally eligible sessions.
panel_feasibility_rule.role: Determines only whether stationary-height correction is structurally estimable. Failure does not count as evidence for or against tag bias.

deployment_metadata_audit.report: For each frozen biological individual, report distinct non-empty deployment/tag identifiers where available. No pass/fail rule.

temporal_overlap_summary.unit: pairs of repeat individuals within the same originally admitted cohort
temporal_overlap_summary.individual_window: minimum to maximum timestamp across that individual's originally eligible sessions in the cohort
report: median absolute difference in tracking-window start dates, days
temporal_overlap_summary.inferential_role: descriptive limitation only; this v1 audit does not open a new time-block permutation family

stop_rule: Do not inspect or parse numeric vertical values during preflight.
Do not change speed threshold, gap threshold, 100-m grid, shared-cell support, individual support, or panel feasibility thresholds after any preflight output is opened.
If few panels are structurally eligible for stationary correction, retain that fact and rely on the separately predeclared shift-invariant shape audit as the cross-panel primary tag-offset test.
No new source search or device metadata enrichment after output.
